description: List the items in the project or in one bin, with their id, kind (bin, clip, sequence), bin path and type. Ids and paths are what other tools take

bin.description: List inside this bin. Default: the project root

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

depth.description: How many bin levels to descend. Default 10

limit.description: At most this many items. Default 500

selected.description: List the items selected in the Project panel instead

name: list_project_items
title: List Project Items
